finding.summary: WatchdogTransport only implements handle_request (sync) but not handle_async_request. If used with httpx.AsyncClient, it will raise NotImplementedError. The current codebase uses httpx.Client (sync) so it works today, but the transport is incomplete as a BaseTransport implementation.
finding.fix: Add handle_async_request method that wraps the async response stream with an async version of _WatchedStream, or explicitly document/raise that async is not supported.
